script: facts, relationship, clarity, emotional purpose, timing and common sense; reject defects with evidence rather than taste
audio: ffprobe duration, ffmpeg silence, STT diff, speaking rate, speaker similarity against hashed storyteller sample, direct listening for integrity/delivery/safety
characters: important cast and age completeness, actual references, likeness, stylized rendering, anatomy, consistency, four full-body views and eight expressions
reviewerIndependence: distinct actual worker from author; IDs do not prove independence by themselves
proofScope: isolated contract/HTTP/media-measurement tests, no real provider quality proof
finalization: current asset and renderer hashes, technical gates, qualified Vera full-file visual pass and independent qualified Ava full-file audio pass, then human; freeze advisory

evaluationFoundation.knownAnatomyDefect: inconclusive/missed by local rules; actual model inspection pending
evaluationFoundation.productionRouting: advisory existing evidence plus mandatory pre-video visual qualification; no current production judge qualified
evaluationFoundation.langsmith: optional local examples export; no upload or tracing enabled

backgrounds: scene-first direction, known/proposed facts, staging space, empty environments, style, continuity, separate review/human lock for each required angle
keyframes: exact shot/reference bindings; full-frame measured 16:9 at least 1280x720; scene fit, likeness, anatomy, setting continuity, staging, style, composition; independent direct-image review then human
visualQualification: minimum 2 good + 2 broken heldout examples per image/video × anatomy/identity/continuity; zero errors; actual verified files; trusted operator labels; no current judge is qualified
video: entire-file direct-video coverage bound to qualified worker/model and current hash; localized rejection repair; no guarantee all defects detected
sound: actual direct listening for piano/no vocals/fit, measured duration, provenance/usage rights
assembly: Shared Remotion composition; FFmpeg audio mix, original narration at 0/15/30/45, no atempo, approved trims/ducking/fades
audioQualification: separate actual held-out human-labelled audio; integrity/transcript/natural-rate/voice-match/mix/safety each minimum two usable and two broken, zero errors; model/tool profile bound; no production Ava currently qualified

supervisedV1.perception: required direct actual media; unavailable stays inconclusive
supervisedV1.qualification: deferred; no invented scores or human labels
supervisedV1.provisional: advisory candidate with direct perception, no known failing criterion; human confirms all media criteria
supervisedV1.voiceIdentity: human comparison against original sample; score unavailable until calibrated tool connected
supervisedV1.regression: invented binding/routing corpus, never qualification evidence
